description: Defines data structures, constants, macros, and API functions related to Redis cluster management, including cluster nodes, links, messages, and cluster state.

classes.name: clusterLink
classes.description: Encapsulates the connection details to a remote cluster node, including socket descriptor, buffers, and associated node.

classes.name: clusterNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Redis cluster, including its identity, state, slots, links, and failure reports.

classes.name: clusterState
classes.description: Maintains the overall state of the Redis cluster, including nodes, slots, failover info, and election data.

classes.name: clusterMsg
classes.description: Defines the structure of messages exchanged between cluster nodes, including message types, sender info, and payloads.

methods.name: getNodeByQuery
methods.description: Retrieves a cluster node based on a client query, command, or hash slot.

methods.name: clusterRedirectBlockedClientIfNeeded
methods.description: Redirects a client to the appropriate node if it is blocked and needs redirection.

methods.name: clusterRedirectClient
methods.description: Redirects a client to a specific cluster node for a given hash slot and error code.
